question: Which player received the Purple Cap in the IPL 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohammad Shami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mohammad Shami**, the Indian fast bowler, won the Purple Cap in IPL 2023 for taking the highest number of wickets in the tournament.
 
• He took a total of **28 wickets** in 17 matches, showcasing his exceptional bowling performance throughout the season.
 
• Shami played a key role in leading his team, the **Gujarat Titans**, to the finals of the IPL 2023.
 
• He maintained an impressive **economy rate of 8.03** and consistently delivered in the powerplay overs.
 
• Shami's dominance in the tournament was a testament to his skill in swinging the ball and executing yorkers effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purple Cap in IPL:**

 
 
• The Purple Cap is awarded to the bowler with the most wickets in a single IPL season.
 
• It was introduced in the inaugural season of IPL in 2008.
 
• The cap is passed on from one bowler to another during the season, depending on who tops the wicket-taker list.
 
• At the end of the tournament, the highest wicket-taker retains the Purple Cap.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat Titans:**
 
 
• The Gujarat Titans are a franchise cricket team that debuted in IPL 2022.
 
• They won the IPL title in their inaugural season under the leadership of Hardik Pandya.
 
• The team is based in Ahmedabad and plays its home matches at the Narendra Modi Stadium.
 
 
 
• **IPL 2023 Overview:**
 
 
• IPL 2023 was the 16th edition of the Indian Premier League.
 
• The tournament featured 10 teams and was played across various venues in India.
 
• The Chennai Super Kings defeated the Gujarat Titans in the final to win their 5th IPL title.
 
 
 
• **Bowling Economy:**
 
 
• Bowling economy rate refers to the average number of runs a bowler concedes per over.
 
• A lower economy rate is considered better and indicates control over the game.
 
• Shami's economy rate of 8.03 in IPL 2023 was commendable, especially in T20 cricket.
